name: October 5, 2022 Regular Meeting - Notice of Adjournment
agenda_text:
Notice of Adjournment
  Malibu Public Safety Commission
  Regular Meeting

Please take notice that the Public Safety Commission Regular Meeting of
Wednesday, October 5, 2022, is hereby adjourned to Wednesday, October 12, 2022,
at 5:00 p.m.

The Adjourned Regular meeting will be held via teleconference only in order to
reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to AB 361 and the County of
Los Angeles Public Health Officer’s Order (revised September 22, 2022). Please
visit https://malibucity.org/VirtualMeeting to find more information about how to
participate in the meeting.

Should there be any questions regarding this notice, please call the City Manager’s
Office at (310) 456-2489 ext. 232.

Dated: September 23, 2022 at 4:00 p.m.

__________________________________
Mary Linden, Executive Assistant
